_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula 16 = LEITURA (aula par) no formato CONVERSA (atualizacao 01/10/2026 do CURRICULO): formas de futuro em contraste (will x going to x present continuous, o grau de decisao). Era a aula 10 do desenho original; volta na ordem do curriculo. Tema bloco D (arte e moda); fato dono: ela quer ser estilista. Leitura sempre em voz alta, juntas. Video em aula (YouTube nocookie). Vozes iguais as aulas 1-15.

lesson.subtitle: Lesson 16 -- The Fashion Show Plan
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Sophia | Lesson 16 -- The Fashion Show Plan
lesson.grammar_point: future forms in contrast: will vs going to vs present continuous (degree of decision)

listenings.text: Sophia, it's Ruby. Big change of plan! The fashion show isn't on Friday anymore. The teacher has just told us: we're presenting on Monday, at two. Bia can't come on Monday, so I'll walk the runway for her. And guess what? I'm going to wear the skirt I made from my brother's jeans. Are you free on Saturday? I'm meeting Bia at the fabric store at eleven. Come with us!

paras: The school fashion show is in three weeks, and our group is finally ready to start. We're presenting our collection on Friday the 20th, at ten in the morning, in the gym. Mrs. Lee is meeting us after class tomorrow to look at our sketches. I'm so nervous!

Here is the plan. We're going to make five outfits, all from old clothes. I'm going to turn my brother's old jeans into a skirt, and Bia is going to sew sequins on an old T-shirt. Our mood board is full of colors from Rio: blue, green and a lot of yellow.

Then, last night, disaster: my sewing machine broke in the middle of a stitch! I almost cried. Then I had an idea. OK, I'll ask my grandma. She has an old machine, and she knows everything about fabric. Oh, and look at my desk right now: my cat is sitting on my sketches. This is going to be a long three weeks.

gist.prompt: What is the blog really about?
choices: How to fix a sewing machine at home.
A group getting ready for a school fashion show, and a problem on the way.
Why Ruby's grandmother wants to open her own fashion store in Rio this year.

items: The show is on a Friday morning.
“We're presenting our collection on Friday the 20th, at ten in the morning.”
Ruby is going to make a skirt from new fabric.
“I'm going to turn my brother's old jeans into a skirt.” Old jeans, not new fabric.
Ruby planned to ask her grandma before the machine broke.
“Then I had an idea. OK, I'll ask my grandma.” She decided right then.
Mrs. Lee is looking at the sketches tomorrow.
“Mrs. Lee is meeting us after class tomorrow to look at our sketches.”
